{{Quote|How many did we lose ''this'' time?''"<br />"''Only ''Skud,'' Jabba.|Mosep Bineed (impersonating Jabba the Hutt) and his minion|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 28">[[Star Wars (1977) 28|''Star Wars'' (1977) 28]]</ref>}}
'''Skud''' was a red-skinned humanoid henchman of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]]. He accompanied the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to [[Orleon]], but was killed in a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fight with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].
